Fulton-Montgomery Community College, New York invites applications for

from international students studying in the first year at the college. This scholarship aims to support the study of all international students residing on campus who enrol in Fall 2020 and beyond. Selected students will receive an annual scholarship of USD 5,000.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
Be an international admitted student of the college
Maintain a cumulative GPA of at least 2.0
Enrol and successfully complete a minimum of 12 credits (exception may be granted) for Fall and Spring semesters and remain in satisfactory academic standing
The selected scholars will get an annual scholarship of USD 5,000, which will be directly deducted from their fee.
Follow the steps below to apply for the scholarship:
(All students applying for the housing at the college will be eligible for the scholarship)
Selections will be based on the eligibility criteria.
Scholarship is awarded every academic year of enrollment.
This scholarship award will be an automatic deduction on the semester bill and does not require an application.
